techStack: TypeScript ~6.0.2, ESM modules ('type': 'module'), target es2023, moduleResolution: bundler, verbatimModuleSyntax: true
Vitest v4.1.5 for tests, Supertest v7.2.2 for HTTP integration tests
Zod v4.4.3 for schema validation; custom validate() middleware applies schemas per-route before controllers
cors middleware applied globally; express.json() for body parsing
Route registration order still determines match priority in Express 5 Router — the /compare route is unreachable when /:id is registered first (confirmed by live test failures)
features: apiProductRoutes.ts registers exactly two routes: GET /:id (line 9, first) and GET /compare (line 10, second)
GET /:id: validate(productIdSchema) -> getById controller -> getProductById service -> returns product JSON or 404 via ProductNotFoundError
GET /compare: validate(compareQuerySchema) -> compare controller -> getComparison service -> returns { products, count } JSON
compareService: throws ValidationError for <2, >3, or duplicate IDs; queries SQLite; throws ValidationError if any ID not found
Bug: /:id is registered first so GET /api/products/compare is captured as id='compare', productService returns not-found, endpoint returns 404
compare.test.ts asserts: 200 with products array of length 2 and count 2; id and name present on each product; 400 for fewer than 2 IDs
products.test.ts covers the auth-protected /products router (not apiProductRoutes) — must not regress
architecture: Layer structure: src/routes/ -> src/controllers/ -> src/services/ -> SQLite db (better-sqlite3)
app.ts mounts apiProductRoutes at app.use('/api/products', apiProductRoutes) — no auth middleware on this path
Validated input is set on req.validated by the validate() middleware; controllers read from req.validated, not raw req.params/req.query
Typed errors (ValidationError, ProductNotFoundError) are caught by the global errorHandler middleware registered last in app.ts
New public product routes belong in src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts; always pair with a validate(schema) middleware
edgeCases: Zero IDs (?ids=): Zod array min(2) rejects empty/single-element result — returns 400 before controller
One ID (?ids=1): Zod min(2) rejects — returns 400; compareService also has a redundant guard that is never reached
Missing ids param entirely: Zod treats missing required field as error — returns 400
Two or three IDs: happy path; compareService queries DB and returns { products, count }
More than three IDs: Zod max(3) rejects — returns 400
Duplicate IDs: Zod passes, compareService detects duplicates and throws ValidationError — returns 400
Non-numeric IDs: Zod passes (z.string().min(1)), SQLite won't match string against integer id, compareService throws ValidationError — returns 400
After route reorder: /compare is matched literally before /:id; /:id still matches any segment not equal to 'compare'; no other static routes exist in apiProductRoutes.ts that could be shadowed
/:id continues to accept any string including 'compare' at the schema level, but Express will never route /compare to /:id after the fix

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1–7: GET /api/products/compare must return 200 with products/count; 400 for fewer than 2 IDs; GET /api/products/:id must continue to return 200 or 404 correctly; fix confined to src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts; all tests pass
tasks.description: Swap the route registration order in apiProductRoutes.ts so that router.get('/compare', ...) is registered before router.get('/:id', ...). This gives Express the opportunity to match the static literal path first, making the compare endpoint reachable and leaving the dynamic /:id route fully functional for all other IDs.
